notes.title: Patch 2
notes.content:
Balancing changes
•Reduced duration of Bonelord Gary's Rain Fire attack
•Heart fruit now spawns during fight against the Bonelords
•Various tweaks to levels in Crab Coast and Pumpkin Hollow

Bug fixes
•Fixed rare bug where controller stopped working after beating a level when using Steam Input
•Fixed game crashing if controller was disconnected when in the title screen
•Fixed shark not leaping out of the water far enough to attack the player

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.content:
New features
•Added support for steam input

Balancing changes
•Player starts levels with four hearts instead of three
•Invincible for longer during bat swing attack
•Rotten pier tiles take longer to break
•Various tweaks to levels in Onion Forest and Crab Coast 
•Nerfed Crab Coast music, making it less annoying

Bug fixes
•Fixed bug where beehives respawn on top of moving platforms instead of the bottom
•Fixed bug where player could fall through moving platforms if slipping on a banana
•Fixed bug where zombie rat boss caused bridge tiles to vibrate too violently when slamming the ground
